name: fix_axum_error_status_mapping
description: Maps typed repository errors to correct HTTP statuses in the handler
prompts: The POST /withdraw handler in src/handlers.rs maps EVERY WithdrawError from the repository to HTTP 500, so a missing account and an overdraft both look like server errors. Fix the handler to match the typed variants (exported from src/repository.rs): WithdrawError::NotFound must map to 404 NOT_FOUND and WithdrawError::InsufficientFunds to 409 CONFLICT, keeping a JSON {"error": ...} body. A successful withdrawal still returns 200 with {"balance": <new balance>}. Do not change src/repository.rs.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "webapp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
